heading: Chess Club
text: Chess club runs weekly at 4pm at the school garden or at a nearby cafe. Always free, all skill levels and ages are welcome. We go to three tournaments in Manhattan a year. Come play with us!

heading: Garden Club
text: Middle school grades, no experience needed — every Wednesday, 3-4pm in the school garden. See below for the full program.

heading: Music Theatre
text: The Dr. Michael Conti PS5 Theater Club offers musical theater to students in grades 4–8, culminating in a live performance. Rehearsals led by Ms. Valentin engage students creatively through singing, acting, set design, and costume making.
